Job description

Department Overview



Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. As a part of Gas Engineering, Gas Transmission Engineering is responsible for all aspects of PG&E's gas transmission asset family, including integrity management, pipeline services, threat identification and assessment scoping, process safety, and project engineering and design. The Gas Transmission Engineering and Design group (GTED), part of the Gas Transmission Engineering organization, is focused on providing the technical direction and design of gas transmission pipeline projects and supporting the execution of the work in the field.

The group also provides technical review and approval of project documentation post construction to ensure company records are updated accurately and reflect the scope of work performed. The Design and Drafting group within GTED is responsible for updating record drawings of facilities based on the as-found or as-built condition at the conclusion of the work.



Position Summary



The expert 3D CAD Records & Data Analyst serves as a key liaison between the Records team, Engineering groups, and program leadership within Gas Transmission Engineering and Design. This role supports the integration of 3D modeling into project workflows while managing the end-to-end records lifecycle for engineering deliverables, including check-in/check-out protocols, version control, and data integrity across systems. The Analyst will coordinate SAP tasks related to drawing custody and work order management, maintain and enhance reporting dashboards, and support cross-functional collaboration between engineering, drafting, construction, and records teams. jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer - Renewable Energy Systems (Fully remote, hybrid or office-based)
jobs.desc:
Every utility-scale renewable energy project begins long before construction starts. Its efficiency, reliability and long-term performance depend on engineering decisions made at the design stage.

 

At SUNOTEC, Electrical Design Engineers contribute to the development of the infrastructure behind large-scale renewable energy projects – from initial analysis and technical design to the development of grid-connected systems.

 

With more than 680 completed renewable energy projects, over 15 GW of installed capacity, 6 GWh of battery energy storage capacity and operations across more than 24 countries, SUNOTEC is building the infrastructure that supports global energy transition. More than 2,000 specialists across different countries work together to solve complex engineering challenges across solar power plants, battery storage systems and grid infrastructure.

 

To support the growth of our engineering team in Bulgaria, we are looking for an Electrical Design Engineer - Renewable Energy Systems who wants to contribute to projects with international scale and real impact.

 

Why this role matters:

As an Electrical Design Engineer - Renewable Energy Systems, you will be part of the team that transforms project concepts into technical solutions ready for implementation.

You will take ownership of the electrical design and optimization of photovoltaic power plants and battery storage installations (BESS) , with your engineering decisions directly influencing project efficiency, reliability and successful delivery.

You will collaborate closely with engineers from different disciplines, project managers, transmission and distribution system operators, as well as external partners, to deliver high-quality renewable energy infrastructure.
